submittedArguments.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create ONE refined technology research tree screen for "Mindustry", functional design based on v160.7 ResearchDialog and SerpuloTechTree, with Daoist chibi factory art. Landscape 16:9; request 2560 x 1440 native; opaque.
Image 1 mail UI and Image 2 team UI are PRIMARY approved style references. Closely preserve jade-green heading plates, ivory silk-paper fields, thin warm gold edges, round carved cloud/ruyi corners, precise soft hand-painted lighting, readable dark-jade Chinese, restrained red tassels. Do not copy their game titles, portraits or page contents.
Composition: ivory research canvas occupies most of screen, with unobtrusive soft teal landscape visible around a slim frame. Top-center jade title "科技树"; beneath it a compact planet/root selector "Serpulo" with down arrow. Small "Mindustry" upper-left. Top-right circular X.
Main canvas left 73%: spacious node graph with THREE horizontal rows of large rounded square painted building icons. Fine gold orthogonal connection lines behind nodes. Avoid crossings and all lines must end at a node. Use no dense forest of tiny labels.
Accurate visible sample dependencies:
"核心" at far left branches into upper "传送带" and lower "机械钻头".
Upper branch: "传送带" -> "交叉器" -> "路由器". Then "路由器" branches to three separate nodes "分配器", "分类器", "传送带桥". The first four upper nodes have green check indicators (already unlocked); "分类器" is selected with bright gold halo and small partial progress ring; "分配器" and "传送带桥" are available ivory nodes without checkmarks.
Lower branch: "机械钻头" branches to "机械泵", "石墨压缩机", "燃烧发电机". Mechanical drill is unlocked with check; pump and graphite press are available ivory nodes; combustion generator is visibly greyed and carries a lock (objective still unmet). Do not connect its future descendants. Render every name clearly below its own icon.
Building icons are distinct rounded jade/bronze mechanisms: core hexagonal Taoist machine house, conveyor belt, four-way crossing, tri-way router, larger multiway distributor, sorter with color-filter crystals, conveyor bridge, drill, pump, press and furnace generator. Retain industrial identities.
Right 25%: ivory selected-node detail panel with jade heading "分类器", large matching sorter icon. Exact body: "研究进度 40%" with 40%-filled jade bar; "剩余需求"; copper icon and "铜 120"; lead icon and "铅 60". Small cream button "详细信息". Jade primary button "研究". A compact separate locked-condition strip at bottom of panel reads "燃烧发电机" then lock icon and "需要：研究煤炭". These are demonstration quantities, not asserted game costs.
Top-left narrow resource availability strip: "铜 2,400" and "铅 1,200".
Bottom: cream "返回" left; cream "数据库" right; center small state legend "已解锁" green check, "可研究" ivory, "条件未满足" gray lock. Tiny note "示例分支 · 数值演示".
Precise lines, aligned legible labels, generous spacing, no ambiguous arrows or duplicated nodes. This is a game screen showing a selected tech node, not an infographic poster. No portraits, no shop, no "五行奇谈", no photorealism, no plastic shine, no watermark. Target configured GPT Image 2.5 highest quality.
